# Draft:James Stewart Finley

James Stewart Finley
1940 - 2023 was born in Belfast, Northern Ireland. He specialised in zoology. In 1968 he took up the position as  lecturer in University College Galway and in 1991 became associate professor. He was awarded a doctorate in science in Queen's University 1989
Among his publications:-
Fairly, J.S.1975 ''An Irish Beast Book, A natural history of Ireland's furred wildlife . Blackstaff Press, Belfast.
Fairly, J. 2001 A Basket of Wealses. Published privately. ISBN 09502626 2 5
REFERENCE
Shiel, C. 2023 Obituary James Stewart Finley. '''Irish Naturalists' Journal 40'.178 - 180.
